G1000.def: from «906»; a throw (as a measure of distance):--cast.

G1003.def: of Hebrew origin («01162»); Booz, (i.e. Boaz), an Israelite:--Booz.

G1005.def: of uncertain derivation; the north (properly, wind):--north.

G1006.et: a prol. form of a primary verb, cf (977) &version=kjv& (1016)
G1006.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (compare «977», «1016»); to pasture; by extension to, fodder; reflexively, to graze:--feed, keep.

G1007.def: of Hebrew origin («01160»); Bosor (i.e. Beor), a Moabite:--Bosor.

G1009.def: of uncertain derivation; a bunch (of grapes):--(vine) cluster (of the vine).

G1010.def: from «1011»; an adviser, i.e. (specially) a councillor or member of the Jewish Sanhedrin:--counsellor.

G1011.def: from «1012»; to advise, i.e. (reflexively) deliberate, or (by implication) resolve:--consult, take counsel, determine, be minded, purpose.

G1012.def: from «1014»; volition, i.e. (objectively) advice, or (by implication) purpose:--+ advise, counsel, will.

G1014.et: middle voice of a primary verb
G1014.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to "will," i.e. (reflexively) be willing:--be disposed, minded, intend, list, (be, of own) will (-ing). Compare «2309».

G1015.def: probably of foreign origin; a hillock:--hill.

G1016.def: probably from the base of «1006»; an ox (as grazing), i.e. an animal of that species ("beef"):--ox.

G1017.et: from brabeus (an umpire of uncertain derivation)
G1017.def: from brabeus (an umpire of uncertain derivation); an award (of arbitration), i.e. (specially) a prize in the public games:--prize.

G1018.def: from the same as «1017»; to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail):--rule.

G1020.et: from (1021) and a prolonged form of (4126)
G1020.def: from «1021» and a prolonged form of «4126»; to sail slowly:--sail slowly.

G1021.def: of uncertain affinity; slow; figuratively, dull:--slow.

G1023.et: properly, comparative of (1024), but apparently in the sense of brasso (to wield)
G1023.def: properly, comparative of «1024», but apparently in the sense of brasso (to wield); the arm, i.e. (figuratively) strength:--arm.

G1024.def: of uncertain affinity; short (of time, place, quantity, or number):--few words, little (space, while).

G1025.def: of uncertain affinity; an infant (properly, unborn) literally or figuratively:--babe, (young) child, infant.

G1026.def: a primary verb; to moisten (especially by a shower):--(send) rain, wash.

G1031.def: a primary verb; to grate the teeth (in pain or rage):--gnash.

G1032.def: a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. (by implication) to gush:--send forth.

G1033.def: from the base of «977»; food (literally or figuratively), especially (ceremonially) articles allowed or forbidden by the Jewish law:--meat, victuals.

G1035.def: from the base of «977»; (abstractly) eating (literally or figuratively); by extension (concretely) food (literally or figuratively):--eating, food, meat.

G1036.def: from «1037»; to sink; by implication, to drown:--begin to sink, drown.

G1037.def: a variation of «899»; depth, i.e. (by implication) the sea:--deep.

G1039.def: from «1040»; made of linen (neuter a linen cloth):--fine linen.

G1040.def: of Hebrew origin («0948»); white linen:--fine linen.

G1041.def: from the base of «939»; properly, a stand, i.e. (specially) an altar:--altar.

G1042.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «01355»); the knoll; gabbatha, a vernacular term for the Roman tribunal in Jerusalem:-- Gabbatha.

G1043.def: of Hebrew origin («01403»); Gabriel, an archangel:--Gabriel.

G1045.def: of Hebrew origin («01410»); Gad, a tribe of Israelites:--Gad.

G1046.et: from Gadara (a town east of the Jordan)
G1046.def: from Gadara (a town east of the Jordan); a Gadarene or inhabitant of Gadara:--Gadarene.

G1048.def: of Hebrew origin («05804»); Gazah (i.e. Azzah), a place in Palestine:--Gaza.

G1049.def: from «1047» and «5438»; a treasure-house, i.e. a court in the temple for the collection-boxes:--treasury.

G1050.def: of Latin origin; Gaius (i.e. Caius), a Christian:--Gaius.

G1052.def: from «1053»; a Galatian or inhabitant of Galatia:--Galatian.

G1053.def: of foreign origin; Galatia, a region of Asia:--Galatia.

G1054.def: from «1053»; Galatic or relating to Galatia:--of Galatia.

G1056.def: of Hebrew origin («01551»); Galiloea (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine:--Galilee.

G1057.def: from «1056»; Galilean or belonging to Galilea:--Galilean, of Galilee.

G1058.def: of Latin origin; Gallion (i.e. Gallio), a Roman officer:--Gallio.

G1059.def: of Hebrew origin («01583»); Gamaliel (i.e. Gamliel), an Israelite:--Gamaliel.

G1060.def: from «1062»; to wed (of either sex):--marry (a wife).

G1061.def: from «1062»; to espouse (a daughter to a husband):--give in marriage.

G1063.def: a primary particle; properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles):--and, as, because (that), but, even, for, indeed, no doubt, seeing, then, therefore, verily, what, why, yet.

G1064.def: of uncertain derivation; the stomach; by analogy, the matrix; figuratively, a gourmand:--belly, + with child, womb.

G1065.pos:
1. indeed, truly, at least
  2. even
  3. if indeed, seeing that
G1065.et: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed)
G1065.def: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed):--and besides, doubtless, at least, yet.

G1066.def: of Hebrew origin («01439»); Gedeon (i.e. Gid(e)on), an Israelite:--Gedeon (in the King James Version).

G1067.def: of Hebrew origin (1516 and «02011»); valley of (the son of) Hinnom; ge-henna (or Ge-Hinnom), a valley of Jerusalem, used (figuratively) as a name for the place (or state) of everlasting punishment:--hell.

G1068.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «01660» and «08081»); oil-press; Gethsemane, a garden near Jerusalem:--Gethsemane.

G1069.def: from «1093»; a neighbour (as adjoining one's ground); by implication, a friend:--neighbour.

G1070.def: of uncertain affinity; to laugh (as a sign of joy or satisfaction):--laugh.

G1071.def: from «1070»; laughter (as a mark of gratification):--laughter.

G1072.def: transitive from «1073»; to fill entirely:--fill (be) full.

G1073.def: a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. be full:--be full.

G1074.def: from (a presumed derivative of) «1085»; a generation; by implication, an age (the period or the persons):--age, generation, nation, time.

G1075.def: from «1074» and «3056»; to reckon by generations, i.e. trace in genealogy:--count by descent.

G1076.def: from the same as «1075»; tracing by generations, i.e. "genealogy":--genealogy.

G1077.def: neuter plural of a derivative of «1078»; birthday ceremonies:--birthday.

G1078.def: from the same as «1074»; nativity; figuratively, nature:--generation, nature(-ral).

G1079.et: from a presumed derivative of the base of (1074)
G1079.def: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of «1074»; birth:--birth.

G1080.def: from a variation of «1085»; to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate:--bear, beget, be born, bring forth, conceive, be delivered of, gender, make, spring.

G1081.def: from «1080»; offspring; by analogy, produce (literally or figuratively):--fruit, generation.

G1082.def: of Hebrew origin (compare «03672»); Gennesaret (i.e. Kinnereth), a lake and plain in Palestine:--Gennesaret.

G1085.def: from «1096»; "kin" (abstract or concrete, literal or figurative, individual or collective):--born, country(-man), diversity, generation, kind(-red), nation, offspring, stock.

G1086.def: of Hebrew origin («01622»); a Gergesene (i.e. Girgashite) or one of the aborigines of Palestine:--Gergesene.

G1087.def: from «1088»; the eldership, i.e. (collectively) the Jewish Sanhedrin:--senate.

G1089.def: a primary verb; to taste; by implication, to eat; figuratively, to experience (good or ill):--eat, taste.

G1091.def: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of «1092»; cultivable, i.e. a farm:--husbandry.

G1092.def: from «1093» and the base of «2041»; a land-worker, i.e. farmer:--husbandman.

G1093.def: contracted from a primary word; soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application):--country, earth(-ly), ground, land, world.

G1096.et: a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb
G1096.def: a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb; to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.):--arise, be assembled, be(-come, -fall, -have self), be brought (to pass), (be) come (to pass), continue, be divided, draw, be ended, fall, be finished, follow, be found, be fulfilled, + God forbid, grow, happen, have, be kept, be made, be married, be ordained to be, partake, pass, be performed, be published, require, seem, be showed, × soon as it was, sound, be taken, be turned, use, wax, will, would, be wrought.

G1097.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb
G1097.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed):--allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand.

G1098.def: akin to «1099»; sweet wine, i.e. (properly) must (fresh juice), but used of the more saccharine (and therefore highly inebriating) fermented wine:--new wine.

G1099.def: of uncertain affinity; sweet (i.e. not bitter nor salt):--sweet, fresh.
